# wow-forever-fishing-addon — WoW Forever Fishing Addon ByJTT

> One-click fishing, lure & pole helpers, bite alert + session catch tracker for **World of Warcraft: Forever**. ByJTT foundation addon (solo dev studio: **ByJTT**).
>
> **Project status / full context (humans + AI):** see [`HANDOFF.md`](HANDOFF.md). Agent rules: [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md).

- Repo: https://github.com/ByJTT/wow-forever-fishing-addon
- Display name (TOC Title, “AddonName ByJTT” style): `WoW Forever Fishing Addon ByJTT`
- In-game addon folder name (critical, must remain stable): `ForeverFishing`
- Purpose: one-click fishing casts, lure/pole status + one-click re-lure, bite alert, catch + per-zone fish tracking.
- Scope/target: World of Warcraft: Forever (Interface 16001, 30300). Feature-detected API fallbacks. No Ace/framework deps.
- Install path: `<WoW Forever>/Interface/AddOns/ForeverFishing/ForeverFishing.toc`
- Required in-game files: `ForeverFishing.toc`, `ForeverFishing.lua`.
- Commands: `/ffish help|config|cast|lure|stats|zones|reset|test|debug|onboarding|rl-alias-free` (see README).
- Safety: SecureActionButtonTemplate attribute casting; **no** `OnClick`/`PreClick`/`PostClick` on secure buttons; protected changes deferred out of combat (`InCombatLockdown`/`PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED`).
- Branding/support (public): by ByJTT · https://byjtt.com · https://github.com/ByJTT · Support placeholder: https://buymeacoffee.com/ByJTT (replace with real URL when ready).
- Issues: include WoW Forever build/interface, addon version (`/ffish debug`), steps, expected/actual, Lua errors (`/console scriptErrors 1`). No account data/local personal paths.
- License: MIT.
